scope: Per-size grade-run validation and saved-base approval gates

decisions.pomComparison: Exact raw numeric equality; no tolerance or rounding
decisions.wholeRunOutputs: Withheld until an approved plan exists and every declared size passes current validation
decisions.oneSizeWithoutPlan: Existing standalone one-size exports remain available under their existing checks

remediations: Every drafted plan-size block, including semantic replay output, now runs recipe guidance, shared plausibility/coherence checks, stitch integrity, recipe construction checks, and notch declaration checks.
Plan-driven selected-size and whole-run outputs now require a current approved plan based on the saved active design.
S251 evidence wording now identifies Tech Pack, Projector, and Marker as whole-run outputs and accurately describes the negative nonzero-delta POM test.

verification.savedBaseGate: npx vitest run src/ui/app.test.ts -t "gates whole-run outputs on exact plan readiness and invalidates approval after edits" — 1/1 passed
verification.build: npm run build — passed, 129 Vite modules
verification.protectedExports: All eight approved legacy export identities passed the full regression gate; hashes remain as recorded in S251-graded-output-verification.json. No baseline changed.

renderedReview.result: The Style view visibly presents the explicit Grade plan entry, states that no chart is filled from another size, and explains exact unrounded POM reconciliation before files can be used.

limitations: Successful seven-recipe Tech Pack, Projector, and Marker parity still uses zero-delta size rules; the positive output case does not independently establish distinct-size geometry.
The nonzero-delta test proves changed sizes are blocked by exact POM mismatch; it is not positive distinct-size output evidence.
Digital drafting and output checks do not establish physical fit, population validity, manufacturing tolerance, sample approval, or factory readiness.
